metadata.title: Conformally Sasakian manifolds and the $k$-nullity condition
metadata.abstract: We study almost contact metric manifolds that are locally conformal to Sasakian manifolds in the normalization of Olszak. We show that the local conformal factors are uniquely determined by the structure; consequently, every such manifold is globally conformal to a Sasakian manifold and its Lee form is exact. We then investigate the $k$-nullity condition $ R(X,Y)\xi=k\{\eta(Y)X-\eta(X)Y\}. $ We prove that a smooth nullity function is necessarily constant, including in dimension three. Moreover, the $k$-nullity condition is equivalent to the assertion that $f=\exp(\sigma)$ satisfies $ \mathrm{Hess}_g f=-(kf+C)g $ for a constant $C$, and hence to the fact that the conformal metrics $g$ and $g_0=\exp(-2\sigma)g$ have the same geodesic circles. We derive the range of the conformal factor, a local warped-product description, and a classification in the complete case: when the Lee form is nonzero, the complete metric is a simply connected space form of curvature $k$. Finally, we construct incomplete examples of nonconstant sectional curvature in every dimension $2n+1\geq 5$.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 共形 Sasakian 结构的零化曲率条件与完备分类
analysis.workSummary: 在 Olszak 变换 (φ,e^σξ,e^(−σ)η,e^(−2σ)g) 下，由 dη 在 ker η 上的迹逐点决定 e^(−σ)，所以局部因子拼成全局因子且 Lee 形式 ω=dσ。若光滑函数 K 满足 R(X,Y)ξ=K{η(Y)X−η(X)Y}，则 K 在各连通分支为常数，包括三维。
techniques: Olszak 共形归一化及接触恒等式
concircular Hessian 方程与第一积分
Obata 与 Tashiro 完备刚性
analysis.breakthrough: 连通且 ω 非恒零时，k-零化等价于 f=e^σ 满足 Hess_g f=−(kf+C)g，也等价于两共形度量的测地圆一致。第一积分为 |df|²+kf²+2Cf+1=0。非临界水平叶全脐，局部扭曲因子由 f′ 给出。完备 g 在 k>0、=0、<0 时分别等距于曲率 k 的圆球面、欧氏空间、双曲空间，三种情况都有例子。
analysis.limitations: 全局共形化使用指定归一化。Hessian 充要关系和完备分类保留连通及 ω 非恒零假设。扭曲积仅在 df≠0 的局部邻域成立，紧致时还得到 k=(min e^(−σ))(max e^(−σ))>0。文中的不完备非恒曲率例覆盖奇数维≥5。补读定理、曲率到 Hessian 的路线与完备刚性论证，未独立验证全部曲率计算和外部分类定理。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。完整26页原提取、候选及点写AI、拆行模型名、Danus、HyProver/Hunyuan补检未见作者生成式AI使用声明。第25页致谢仅列资助。结论限于该版本未观察到披露。
